overview.description: The Polen Euro High Yield Bond ETF (PCEB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund targets high-yield, euro-denominated fixed income securities of corporate issuers. It employs a bottom-up, fundamental investment process, emphasizing downside protection. PCEB was launched on May 5, 2026 and is issued by Polen.
